name: NYC DOB NOW: Build job filings (new buildings, demolitions, alterations)
publisher: NYC Department of Buildings (NYC Open Data)

outcome.describes: construction of a job started (first permit issued) here

traps.check: First permit marks the start of work; certificates of occupancy mark completion, years later.
Jobs filed in DOB NOW only; most new buildings since 2021, but projects filed earlier in the legacy system are missing.
Coordinates are geocoded to the street frontage; match lots by BBL or with polygon_match = nearest.
